parsed.evidence: The large, dark rectangular areas in the lower right and center are excluded from classification as they are darkened pixels (dark holes) surrounded by bright support. However, the bright, unmodified support pixels visible along the boundaries of these dark areas show distinct linear embankments or dikes. The presence of these structured containment walls surrounding the dark voids strongly indicates that the dark areas are water bodies (such as aquaculture ponds or reservoirs) and the bright edges are the man-made banks holding them. Additionally, the bright green patch in the lower left is clearly low vegetation/grass on the bank.
